svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of men in England and Wales who have ever married, by age
Each line represents a birth cohort (e.g., "1980" for men born in 1980), and the horizontal axis shows men's age.
